# Eido

Compact LLM context index for this repository. Reality capture: photo/video
uploads → media-prep → COLMAP SfM → 3D Gaussian Splatting → mesh/`.spz`
artifacts → WebGL gallery at eido.cam. Pre-alpha; read the status before
concluding anything.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions.
- `README.md` → "Current Status" — what runs and what does not. Sections 1–4 are
  vision.
- `README.md` → "9. Roadmap" → "Pending work" — the single pending-work list
  (priority, owner vs engineering).
- `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` — deployment and provisioning runbook.

## Key facts (2026-10-02)

- Web: Next.js 15.5.27 + React 19, React Three Fiber 9, drei 10. Image
  optimizer off with an exact `remotePatterns` allow-list; guarded by
  `apps/web/tests/next-config.test.mjs`.
- API: FastAPI in `apps/api`. Janua tokens verified with PyJWT: key by `kid`,
  RS256 only, `exp` required, 30 s leeway, one rate-limited JWKS re-fetch on an
  unknown `kid` (#27). Audience and issuer configuration is a pending item.
- Georegistration is eido's concern, not Factlas's: `services/media-prep` reads
  GPS EXIF and DJI SRT telemetry, `colmap-sfm` aligns to those priors. The
  hand-off contract is `apps/api/contracts/observation.v1.json`.
- Deploys: every push to `main` builds the images, then CI commits digest pins
  under `infra/k8s/production/`; ArgoCD reconciles.

## Verification

- API: `cd apps/api && ruff check src/ && mypy src/eido_api/ --ignore-missing-imports && pytest tests/`
- Pipeline stages: `pytest services/spz-compress/tests/ services/media-prep/tests/`
- Web: `cd apps/web && pnpm lint && pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm test`

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools.
